title: Implement power/battery characteristic mappings (K.3.6)
description:
Add to gatt_ipso.c static table, power/battery characteristics:

- Battery Level 0x2A19 -> 26251/5700, %
- Battery Power State 0x2A1A -> 26251/5701, enum
- Battery Energy Status 0x2BF0 -> 3331/5700, Wh
- Voltage 0x2B18 -> 3316/5700, V
- Current 0x2AEE -> 3317/5700, A
- Power 0x2B05 -> 3328/5700, W
- Energy 0x2B06 -> 3331/5700, Wh

~7 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.3.6
